dedupe_keys.name: central statistical office of grenada 2021 national housing and population census preliminary report and 2011 web tables with households by toilet facility drinking water lighting garbage disposal cooking fuel wall material and insurance by parish

description: The Central Statistical Office of Grenada posted a preliminary report of the 2021 National Housing and Population Census in April 2025, next to web tables and a full report from the 2011 census. The 2021 report counts 39,076 households and has a housing section with tables by parish on toilet facilities, from flush toilets linked to sewers or septic tanks to pit latrines, main sources of drinking water and lighting, garbage disposal, type and ownership of dwelling, cooking fuel, outer wall material and whether the dwelling is insured. The 2011 table on basic utilities gives, for each parish, the share of households with electricity, treated water inside the dwelling, an indoor toilet and gas for cooking; nationally 88.85 percent had electricity and 73.50 percent treated water inside, but only 0.53 percent in Carriacou and Petite Martinique. Coverage is national by parish. Format and access: free PDFs and HTML tables, no registration. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: 2021 figures are preliminary and some table text runs together when extracted. Simulation uses: hurricane exposure of housing by wall material and insurance, and island water supply gaps. Related records: none for Grenada censuses in the catalogue.
